question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing left back, and Eve is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Dave and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) right back
(C) sweeper
(D) left back
(E) left winger
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve, in that order.
Initial: center midfielder | right back | sweeper | left back | left winger
1. Alice and Claire swap: sweeper | right back | center midfielder | left back | left winger
2. Dave and Eve swap: sweeper | right back | center midfielder | left winger | left back
3. Alice and Eve swap: left back | right back | center midfielder | left winger | sweeper
4. Alice and Claire swap: center midfielder | right back | left back | left winger | sweeper
5. Dave and Claire swap: center midfielder | right back | left winger | left back | sweeper
Dave is playing left back, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
